quickInfo.name: Eject hole
quickInfo.summary: The eject-hole skill shot opens the right gate and spots one KORA letter when the setting permits it.

quickInfo.name: Captive-ball ladder
quickInfo.summary: The first different captive ball scores 30K, the second 40K, and the third 50K; resetting their positions does not lower the value.

quickInfo.name: Reset ball chamber
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left chamber returns every captive ball already hit to a reachable position without resetting its value.

quickInfo.name: KORA
quickInfo.summary: Complete K-O-R-A in the top lanes to raise end-of-ball Bonus X. The open right gate feeds the ball back toward those lanes.

quickInfo.name: 5x Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Bonus X stops at 5x, so preserve the ball after the multiplier and bonus have grown.

steps.text: Plunge for the eject hole. Confirm that it opens the right gate and spots a KORA letter.
Shoot the safer captive ball from a controlled flipper for 30K. That ball moves out of reach.
Hit a different captive ball for 40K, then the remaining ball for 50K.
Shoot the upper-left reset ball chamber to return the hit captive balls to reachable positions. Their raised value remains.
modeNotes: Check captive-ball values and whether their progress and Bonus X carry between balls.

steps.text: Send the ball through the open right gate, then complete K-O-R-A in the top lanes to raise Bonus X toward 5x.
After resetting the balls, repeat the safest captive ball at the raised value while its rebound remains controlled.
After 5x is ready, stop forcing dangerous captive-ball hits. Protect the built bonus with safer top play.

fallback.title: KORA and bonus
fallback.when: Use this when captive-ball rebounds are too dangerous.

steps.text: Feed the top lanes through the eject hole or an open right gate.
Complete K-O-R-A in the top lanes to advance Bonus X toward 5x.
Send the ball through the eject hole or open right gate and score the top lanes to build base bonus.
Return to a captive ball only from a trapped, repeatable feed.

alternatives.title: Chamber-release route
alternatives.when: Use this when captive hits are safe but the full 50K ladder is not needed.

steps.text: Hit the safest captive ball once for 30K.
Shoot the upper-left reset ball chamber to return it to reach without lowering the next captive value.
Repeat that controlled captive-ball and reset sequence while it remains safer than changing captive balls.
Return to KORA and Bonus X when the reset-chamber feed is uncontrolled.
Hit three different captive balls to raise the value from 30K to 40K to 50K.
Use the upper-left reset ball chamber to make the hit captive balls reachable again.
Use the open right gate to feed the top lanes, then complete K-O-R-A until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Carry the maximum multiplier into a large end-of-ball bonus.

techniques.name: Eject-hole skill shot
techniques.instruction: Set the plunge so the ball reaches the eject hole. Use the award to open the right gate before normal play begins.

techniques.name: Captive-ball selection
techniques.instruction: Test both captive balls. Repeat the one that gives the safer return to a flipper.

cautions.issue: Direct captive-ball hits can rebound toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Shoot a captive ball only from control. Change sides if one rebound is not recoverable.

cautions.issue: The right side has two outlane paths, and a weak gate shot can return near them.
cautions.response: Use the gate only after its return is known. Nudge before the ball reaches the lane dividers.

cautions.issue: A closing gate can reject the ball into uncontrolled play.
cautions.response: Confirm the gate lamp before the shot. Keep both flippers ready for a rejected entry.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm whether the top-center eject hole spots KORA and opens the right gate.
Check captive-ball values and whether their progress and Bonus X carry between balls.
Confirm Extra Ball, Special, replay, ball count, and tilt treatment before pursuing those awards.

input.simpleOverview: Algar uses three different captive balls for a 30K, 40K, and 50K ladder, while the upper-left chamber restores every struck ball to reach. Shoot the eject hole to open the right gate, hit all three captive balls, reset them, and repeat while building K-O-R-A and 5x Bonus.

Collect all three values, reset the balls, and use the open gate to reach the K-O-R-A lanes that advance Bonus X to 5x.
